data.description: Discover Elegant Living at Sun City, Dubai
data.display_address: DAMAC Sun City, Dubai Land, Dubai
data.long_description:
Sun City by Damac presents an exceptional collection of four and five-bedroom townhomes in the vibrant Sun City community. These homes combine functional floor plans with breathtaking views of the picturesque surroundings, offering both luxury and practicality.

Each home showcases contemporary architecture that aligns with the latest design trends, while the interiors feature high-quality materials in soft, natural tones, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Sun City residents enjoy a variety of amenities, including scenic forest hiking trails, a dedicated jungle camping area, and a tranquil yoga space in the park. The community also offers a swimming pool with a fountain, sauna, outdoor gym, library, amphitheater, barbecue and picnic spots, and children's playgrounds, providing a truly enriching lifestyle.

Located for optimal convenience, Sun City is just 20 minutes from the metro station, 30 minutes from the airport, and within close reach of popular attractions like Expo City Dubai (23 minutes) and Damac Mall (20 minutes).

Sun City is the ideal home for those who value comfort, luxury, and modern aesthetics in one of Dubai's most dynamic communities.
